name: U.S. Virgin Islands
officialName: Virgin Islands of the United States
facts: Unincorporated territory of the United States

flag.description: A white field with a simplified yellow eagle from the U.S. coat of arms, a red, white and blue shield on its breast, holding a sprig of laurel and three blue arrows, between the blue letters V and I.
flag.symbolism: The three arrows, in place of the thirteen on the U.S. coat of arms, stand for the three main islands of St Croix, St Thomas and St John; the laurel symbolises victory.

hook: The U.S. Virgin Islands sign their own flag: a gold eagle on white, flanked by a big blue V and I.
trivia: The United States bought the islands from Denmark in 1917 for $25 million in gold.
The capital, Charlotte Amalie, is named after a Danish queen, the wife of King Christian V.
